item: W9 SBOM formal executor image mode
head: 48c1a52a15d6a10c972d0f006b2e5dd06e809c50
summary: Image mode cannot pass the frozen SBOM Policy adapter: the adapter accepts only CycloneDX specVersion 1.6, the pinned image SBOM tool (Trivy 0.76.2) emits specVersion 1.7 with no spec-version selector. Per task red line the frozen adapter was NOT modified and no document was transcoded or relabelled. No executor code was changed, because any image-mode fact carrying a genuine image SBOM evaluates FAIL for format reasons alone, indistinguishable from a tampered or wrong SBOM.
anchorCrossCheck: The documents probed are the step1 originals themselves (sha256 above equals step1 binding record); their metadata.component bom-ref/purl embed the exact child manifest digests and ImageID equals the config digests. Subject binding is intact; the Policy rejection is purely the format-version gate, not a binding failure.

adapterProbe.factShape: exact standalone shape constructed by sbom-real.mjs (stage=standalone, extraction.base64 == files[target/classes/META-INF/sbom/application.cdx.json], .git-sha present, io trio present)
adapterProbe.specIsolation: Rewriting ONLY specVersion 1.7->1.6 on probe copies flips both architectures to PASS at sbomEvidence and sbomParent, proving every other frozen check (CycloneDX format, >=10 components, non-empty dependencies, unique bom-refs, packaged==maven byte equality) is already satisfied by genuine image SBOMs. The rewritten copies were never sealed, shipped or presented as generated output.
adapterProbe.negativeDiscrimination: NOT_ACHIEVABLE in current contract: valid and invalid image SBOMs are rejected at the same format gate with the same reason, so an executor-level positive/negative pair cannot discriminate. Step1 tamper rejection (23/23, incl. one-byte tamper) was verified at the artifactStore/seal layer and is not re-claimed here as an executor result.

gaps.detail: Frozen SBOM Policy adapter (sbom-evidence.mjs) accepts only CycloneDX 1.6; pinned Trivy 0.76.2 image SBOMs are 1.7. Needs a policy decision: (a) amend and re-freeze the adapter/baseline to accept 1.7 (or 1.6+1.7) with new source hashes and regression re-acceptance, or (b) approve introducing/pinning an image SBOM tool that emits 1.6, or (c) close image mode and keep step1 descriptive binding as the final form. Until decided, a formal image mode can only ever FAIL.

Executor/entry work queued behind G-SBOM1: sbom-real image input contract + image project entries (digest-pinned per architecture), a formal restricted sbom-v1 entry on devops (security-trivy or a dedicated identity; step1 proves the generation recipe), registry timeout/capability review for image pulls (30000ms cap and [SBOM_FILE] in shared registry.mjs, currently entangled with other lines uncommitted diffs).

Fact shaping for image mode: standalone fact hardcodes the Maven file path and .git-sha=artifact-sha256 anchor; image facts need a subject-digest anchor design (the SBOM metadata.component bom-ref already embeds the child manifest digest) that the (amended) adapter can check, without weakening the packaged==source byte-equality rule.
